investigation_scope: Baseline Volume Viewport & Defective Rotating Cube Render Analysis

renderer_bypass.details: OceanVolumeViewport.tsx instantiates an inline WebGL2 context directly inside a React useEffect hook, bypassing the modular WebGPU/WebGL2 pipeline, residency management, LOD brick stream, and coordinate transformers.

geometry.rotation_animation: Continuous auto-orbit (angleY += 0.002 per frame) + mouse drag

data_feed.quantization_method: Linear normalization to 1..255 with 0 reserved for land sentinel (-999.0)

raymarching_shader_mechanics.colormap: Hardcoded 4-segment linear piecewise RGB gradient in GLSL
raymarching_shader_mechanics.depth_handling: Linear uniform UVW mapping across non-uniform Copernicus depth levels (0.494m to 5727.9m)
raymarching_shader_mechanics.bathymetry_integration: None (No GEBCO elevation mesh, no seafloor depth clipping)
raymarching_shader_mechanics.wet_mask_integration: Sentinel value <= -900.0 mapped to alpha 0.0 (no discrete uint validity mask buffer)

defects_and_pathologies.title: Standalone Inline Viewport Bypasses Package Architecture
defects_and_pathologies.description: The viewport is an ad-hoc 358-line React component creating its own WebGL2 canvas context and compiling inline shaders, completely ignoring @quasar/renderer-webgpu and @quasar/renderer-webgl2.

defects_and_pathologies.title: Distorted Perspective Ray Reconstruction
defects_and_pathologies.description: Ray direction is calculated as normalize(vLocalPos - uCamPos) on the bounding box vertex surface rather than unprojecting clip-space NDC coordinates through inverse(ViewProjection), causing perspective warping and shearing during camera pitch/yaw.

defects_and_pathologies.title: Non-Uniform Vertical Depth Distortion
defects_and_pathologies.description: Sampling 16 depth levels with linear texture coordinates stretches shallow ocean mixed layer (top 100m) into a tiny sliver while expanding abyssal depths (1000m-5700m) across 80% of the volume height, violating scientific vertical scaling.

defects_and_pathologies.title: Missing Bathymetry & Coastline Geological Bed
defects_and_pathologies.description: No GEBCO 2026 bathymetric terrain mesh is loaded or rendered. The ocean volume floats in empty space as an ungrounded cube without seabed boundaries or continent outlines.

defects_and_pathologies.title: Hardcoded Synthetic UI Data & Disconnected Soundings
defects_and_pathologies.description: App.tsx renders hardcoded synthetic formula mock objects for Pick Reconciliation, Vertical Profile Chart (29.5 - sqrt(depth)*0.92), and ARGO comparison, rather than consuming real backend queries.
